scoring_justification: Frequency is recomputed from the agent's raw frequency data against the theoretical isolated-bond frequency (Eq. 7) using scipy.special.ellipk; envelope and relaxation time are scored by structural metrics; critical amplitude compared to paper's A_c_num ≈ 1.181 with tolerance; power-law exponents compared to paper's reported 0.61 and 0.87. This constitutes a mix of T1 recompute and T0 reference matching, but the strongest tier achievable is recompute.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference critical amplitude A_c = 1.181, gamma = 0.61, delta = 0.87
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: A_c_num ≅ 1.181; power-law exponents approximately 0.61 and 0.87
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, necessary for verification.

outputs.description: Envelope of |q(τ)| at late times for each amplitude.
Breather frequency Ω(A) for A above the critical amplitude.
Relaxation time τ_rel for A below the critical amplitude.
Critical amplitude A_c separating delocalization from localization.

fit_range.description: range of amplitudes used in the power-law fits (e.g., min_A, max_A for each side)

outputs.description: Power-law exponents of divergence of relaxation time and modulation period near A_c.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are derived from the numerical solution of the integro-differential equation. The checker will compare envelope, frequency, relaxation time, critical amplitude, and exponents to paper-reported values (hidden gold) with appropriate tolerances, and verify structural trends (envelope shape, divergence, frequency above band edge). The modulation period extraction is implicit in the power-law exponents step; no separate output file is required for the period values.
